item.title: feynsage: a Tutorial for Someone Starting QFT
item.description: A tutorial for feynsage, a SageMath package for QFT calculations, in the order a first course actually goes: gamma matrices and traces first, then a full scattering cross section for electron positron to muon pair, then loops at the end. Every object is explained before it is used and every output on the page is captured from a real run.
